# Lahman sample

`Batting.csv` and `Pitching.csv` hold the 2002, 2016, 2019, 2020 and 2024 rows (needed columns only) of the SABR Lahman Baseball Database
1871-2025, from https://github.com/cbwinslow/lahman-database-csv (a mirror of the SABR release). The database is copyright
1996-2025 by SABR via the generous donation of Sean Lahman and is licensed CC BY-SA 3.0
(http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/); these files carry the same license. They are used only by
tests/test_lahman_constants.py.
